name: Se~eki Shunkan! Idou?! ~Enkaku Sousa Mahou de, Itsudemo Dokodemo Nakadashi!~
original_name: せーえき瞬間っ！移動？！～遠隔操作魔法で、いつでもどこでも膣内射精（なかだし）！～
source:
The main character has been transferred to a high school. But, girls soon find out that he is a cherry boy, and they tease him. One day, a fairy suddenly appears in front of him, and gives him magic power. His revenge now begins.... 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角已经转学到高中了。但是，女孩们很快发现他是一个樱桃小子，并嘲笑他。有一天，一位仙女突然出现在他面前，并赋予了他神奇的力量。他的复仇现在开始了…… 

[来自工口游戏商店]
